scientific_limitations: Exact stationary moments only, not finite noisy trajectory data.
Independent homogeneous continuous-time binary patches with strictly positive colonization/extinction and pairwise distinct turnover rates.
No claim for correlated environmental shocks, patch interactions, irregular unknown time units or numerical conditioning.
title: Third-order temporal moments identify heterogeneous patch turnover from aggregate occupancy
